mapper.update: UPDATE company_patent cp SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE cp.deleted = false AND cp.company_id IN (SELECT c.company_id FROM company c JOIN run_company rc ON rc.corporate_number = c.corporate_number WHERE rc.run_id = #{runId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM run_patent rp JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = rp.merge_key WHERE p.patent_id = cp.patent_id AND rp.run_id = #{runId})

UPDATE patent_classification pc SET deleted = true, updated_at = now() WHERE pc.deleted = false AND pc.patent_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT p.patent_id FROM run_patent rp JOIN patent p ON p.merge_key = rp.merge_key WHERE rp.run_id = #{runId} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM run_classification rc JOIN classification c ON c.merge_key = rc.merge_key WHERE c.classification_id = pc.classification_id AND rc.run_id = #{runId} )
